suite: r1108 startup and true-return presentation notice criteria
method: The shipped runtime executes in an independent controlled DOM/RAF fixture with explicit lifecycle stimuli and timer delivery. Forbidden getters detect any new audio, count, persistence, network or reload dependency.
limitations: Controlled DOM rectangles and delivered animation callbacks do not establish rendered pixels, a native accessibility tree, physical Android lock/unlock or audible sound.
Historical notice geometry suites remain separate; this suite concentrates on the causal lifecycle and missing-frame decisions.
